items.title: File Buncombe County business personal property return
items.description: Business personal property used in a business on January 1 is listed with the county tax office during January; a listing filed late carries a 10% penalty (N.C.G.S. 105-312(h)). A written extension request made by January 31 can extend the time to April 15 in some counties (March 15 in others).

items.description: Business personal property used in a business on January 1 is listed with the county tax office during January; a listing filed late carries a 10% penalty (N.C.G.S. 105-312(h)). items.title: File Mecklenburg County business personal property return
items.description: North Carolina business personal property is listed with the county tax office from January 1 through January 31; a 10% late-listing penalty applies. Listings are filed online through the Assessor's portal; an extension request by the deadline extends it to April 15.
